notes: Publish TOC and body figures in the same Pages deployment. New captures require a completed Tampermonkey final packet plus strict DOI/source/hash/decode validation; historical staged captures at or before the cutover may backfill only after a 15-minute stability window and the same strict validation. Previously staged eligible body figures are continuously drained. No cross-DOI source, incomplete body packet, invalid marker, unsupported/unsafe image, or missing verified primary graphic may publish. A strictly verified Nature/Science Figure 1 primary can satisfy primary-graphic readiness. A PDF HTTP403 alone does not invalidate completed body figures. All images still require exact DOI/source/hash/decode validation.
